title: Realization of the completed constant direct-image tower with its maps
statement: Fix the finite-field datum $p,a,q,k_0,k$ of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $V=\mathcal O_E$, uniformizer $\varpi$, and $A_n=V/\varpi^n$ for $n\geq1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $Y$ be a separated finite-type $k$-scheme [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], put $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $f:Y\to s$, and use the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Put $F_n=(A_n)_Y$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], $\widehat V_Y=\varprojlim_nF_n$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], $B_n=\operatorname{Res}_n Rf_{*,n}(F_n[0])$ and $B=Rf_*\widehat V_Y$ [def-weil-derived-direct-image]. In these expressions identify the derived reductions of $\widehat V_Y$ with $F_n[0]$ by the canonical projection-induced maps of [lem-weil-constant-coefficient-objects-constructible]. All $B_n$ are thus objects of the same derived category of $\widehat V_s$-modules. Write $C_n=\Gamma(s,B_n)$ and $C=\Gamma(s,B)$, forgetting to abelian groups by exact point sections [lem-weil-point-proetale-sections-exact]. Then applying point sections to the specified derived-limit triangle defining $B$ gives a derived-limit triangle for $(C_n)$ in $D(\operatorname{Ab})$, with the actual projection maps $C\to C_n$ [def-weil-derived-limit]. The degree-zero maps induced by these projections, after finite-reduction and identity-on-sections restriction comparisons [def-trf-point-reduction-units], are exactly the maps $P_n:H^0(Y,V)\to H^0(Y,A_n)$ of ordinary cohomology [def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology]. The degree-zero transition induced by the specified $\mathrm{sfDirectImageTransition}$, under the augmentation identifications $H^0(C_n)=F_n(Y)$, is exactly $F_{n+1}(Y)\to F_n(Y)$ induced by $A_{n+1}\twoheadrightarrow A_n$; with the same comparisons it is $Q_n$. In particular $Q_nP_{n+1}=P_n$. This statement assumes neither connectedness nor finiteness of higher cohomology.

source.place: Tag 0D6K, lemma-RGamma-commutes-with-Rlim; derived.tex Tag 05TD, lemma-left-exact-higher-derived, with the coefficient-restriction square of lem-pod-constant-tower-transition and the specified point-reduction comparisons.

proof.text: Put $K=\widehat V_Y[0]$. By [lem-weil-constant-coefficient-objects-constructible], $K$ is an admissible derived-complete integral coefficient object and its canonical reductions are $F_n[0]$. Apply [lem-weil-constant-scalar-strict-unit] with $L=E$: multiplication $r\otimes z\mapsto\pi_n(r)z$ identifies the reduction unit with $\pi_n$ and commutes with every quotient transition. Thus the reduction transition is the actual quotient $r_n:F_{n+1}\to F_n$, after restriction to completed coefficients. By [def-weil-derived-direct-image], $B$ comes with the specified Roos triangle of the restricted finite images $B_n$; denote its first map by $p:B\to\prod_nB_n$, its coordinate projections by $p_n$, and its tower transitions by $t_n$. No direct-image finite-reduction isomorphism is asserted or needed.

source.place: Canonical quotient tower in def-weil-derived-direct-image; regular-module reduction normalization in lem-weil-constant-scalar-strict-unit.

proof.text: Apply [lem-kun-site-rgamma-derived-limit] on the small ringed site $s_{\mathrm{proet}}$ with ring sheaf $\widehat V_s$ and object $s$ to this very triangle (reindex its sequence starting at $1$). It identifies $R\Gamma(s,\prod_nB_n)$ with $\prod_nR\Gamma(s,B_n)$ by the maps $R\Gamma(s,\mathrm{pr}_n)$ and retains each projection $R\Gamma(s,p_n)$. Since $k$ is algebraically closed, [lem-weil-point-proetale-sections-exact] identifies this derived sections functor with termwise sections, naturally on objects and maps: sections carries a resolution quasi-isomorphism to a quasi-isomorphism. Consequently the image triangle is $C\to\prod_nC_n\xrightarrow{1-s_C}\prod_nC_n\to C[1]$ in $D(\operatorname{Ab})$, with transitions $\Gamma(s,t_n)$ and projections $\Gamma(s,p_n)$. This proves the triangle assertion including its maps.

source.place: Tag 0D6K, lemma-RGamma-commutes-with-Rlim, applied to the target point ringed site.

proof.text: Write $M_n=Rf_{*,n}(F_n[0])$ and let $\rho_n:B\otimes^L_{\widehat V_s}(A_n)_s\to M_n$ be the finite-reduction comparison. By [def-weil-derived-direct-image] it is the adjunct of $p_n$. The unit of [lem-weil-derived-scalar-extension-restriction-adjunction] therefore satisfies $\operatorname{Res}_n(\rho_n)\eta_B=p_n$. Apply sections and the restriction comparison $e$ of [def-trf-point-reduction-units], which is the identity on underlying sections. The composite $e\,\Gamma(s,\operatorname{Res}_n(\rho_n))\,\Gamma(s,\eta_B)$ is exactly $\Gamma(s,p_n)$, with target written as $\Gamma(s,M_n)$. By [def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology], $H^0(C)=H^0(Y,V)$ and $H^0(\Gamma(s,M_n))=H^0(Y,A_n)$. Taking $H^0$ gives precisely the specified $P_n$. This uses the sheaf reduction comparison and its adjunction equation, without replacing it by an arbitrary isomorphism or invoking any ordinary-module tensor comparison for $B$.

source.place: Tag 07A6, lemma-adjoint; finite comparison defined as adjunct of the specified projection.

proof.text: For clarity track the completed-coefficient comparisons in the actual $\mathrm{sfDirectImageTransition}$. Write $G$ for underived direct image over completed coefficients and $R_n$ for restriction from $(A_n)_Y$-modules. Choose nonnegative injective resolutions $a_n:F_n[0]\to I_n$ over $(A_n)_Y$ and $b_n:R_nF_n[0]\to J_n$ over $\widehat V_Y$. Module-sheaf categories have enough injectives by [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist]; [lem-weil-pbc-left-exact-injective-resolution-degree-zero] supplies these nonnegative resolutions, and [lem-weil-pbc-bounded-below-injectives-kinjective] makes them K-injective. The functor $G$ is left exact by the sectionwise kernel calculation: on a target object $U$, direct image evaluates the underlying sheaf at $Y\times_sU$, while coefficient restriction changes only its action. Hence [lem-weil-pbc-left-exact-injective-resolution-degree-zero] identifies $H^0(GJ_n)$ with $G(R_nF_n)$. At finite level [lem-pod-finite-sheaf-h0-augmentation] gives exactly the specified natural augmentation $F_n(Y)\cong H^0(C_n)$.

source.place: Tags 013K and 05TD, nonnegative resolutions and left-exact degree-zero augmentation; Tag 070J, bounded-below injective complexes.

proof.text: Exact restriction makes $R_n(a_n)$ a quasi-isomorphism. By [lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-hom-derived], the derived morphism $b_n\,R_n(a_n)^{-1}$ is represented by a chain map $j_n:R_nI_n\to J_n$ with $j_nR_n(a_n)$ homotopic to $b_n$; $j_n$ is a quasi-isomorphism. In [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition], apply the resolution normalization to the two factorizations through finite and completed coefficients of the same ringed-topos morphism. It says that the canonical comparison $c_n:RG(R_nF_n[0])\to\operatorname{Res}_nM_n$ is the inverse of $G(j_n)$, using the sectionwise equality $GR_n=\operatorname{Res}_nf_{*,n}$. The preceding augmentation equation therefore implies that $c_n$ carries the completed direct-image augmentation to the restricted finite augmentation. By the exact-postcomposition clause of [lem-kun-right-derived-single-h0], taking $H^0$ conjugates $c_n$ to the identity of $f_*F_n$, with its restricted action. Thus the two completed-coefficient comparison factors preserve the actual section elements.

source.place: Tags 070I and 0D6E (sites-cohomology.tex, lemma-derived-pushforward-composition); Tag 05TD, augmentation comparison.

proof.text: Under the quotient identifications of Step 1, the actual transition is $t_n=c_n\,RG(r_n[0])\,c_{n+1}^{-1}$. The middle map is natural on the direct-image augmentation; [lem-kun-right-derived-single-h0] identifies its degree-zero map with $G(r_n)$. Step 5 identifies both outer factors with the identity on the same sections. After exact point sections this gives the section map $r_n(Y):F_{n+1}(Y)\to F_n(Y)$. Equivalently, apply [lem-pod-constant-tower-transition] to $A_{n+1}\twoheadrightarrow A_n$, $F=F_{n+1}$, $G=F_n$ and $u=r_n$; its finite-restriction augmentation square gives this same section map. With [def-trf-point-reduction-units], restriction/sections comparisons again act as the identity on these elements, and [def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology] identifies the two degree-zero groups with the ordinary finite-coefficient cohomology groups. The resulting map is exactly $Q_n$. No flatness of $A_n$ over $A_{n+1}$ is used.

source.place: Tag 05TD, canonical natural degree-zero comparison, and the coefficient-restriction square of lem-pod-constant-tower-transition.

proof.text: By [lem-weil-pbc-hom-into-triangle-exact](i), consecutive maps of the image Roos triangle compose to zero. Therefore $(1-s_C)\Gamma(s,p)=0$. Composing with its $n$-th product projection and using the formula in [def-weil-derived-limit] gives $\Gamma(s,p_n)-\Gamma(s,t_n)\Gamma(s,p_{n+1})=0$. Apply the functor $H^0$ and substitute Steps 3 and 6 to get $P_n-Q_nP_{n+1}=0$. Thus $Q_nP_{n+1}=P_n$. All calculations hold for the empty scheme and for disconnected schemes as well; neither constant sections being all sections nor finiteness of any higher cohomology group has entered.
